# Osteria Rago

> Italian Restaurant in Bloomington, Indiana. An 1880s carriage house off Kirkwood. House-made pasta and wood-fired pizza.

- Phone: (812) 822-0694
- Address: 419 E Kirkwood Ave, Bloomington, IN 47408
- Areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Nashville, Martinsville
- Offers: House-made pasta; Wood-fired pizza; Starters and entrées
- Rating: 4.5 from 712 Google reviews
